description: Turret Enhanced shows its azimuth tape, elevation ladder, target grid and target-marking actions to any crew member in a gunner view, so door gunners and ground gunners get a drone camera overlay. This limits manned vehicles to the seats that get the UKSF camera compass: an aircraft pilot seat with a pilot camera or an aircraft turret with OpticsIn. UAV gunners keep it. The Reaper keeps only its own UKSF camera overlay, which already has a heading scale and elevation ladder. Its north marker shares a display with the target grid, so only the N control is hidden while the player has the UKSF camera compass on. The grid stays and the two north markers never draw together.

ops.replace: if (missionnamespace getVariable "Fat_Lurch_ShowNorth") then {710 cutRsc ["North", "Plain", -1, false]; (ctrlParent (uiNamespace getVariable "myUI_LevelTitle") displayCtrl 709) ctrlShow !(ACE_player getVariable ["uksf_vehicles_cameraCompass", false]);};
